Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays on chembl_id CHEMBL1217643, join activities on assay_id, join molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter to exact measurements where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value and standard_relation are not null. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
